articles.article_title: Nvidia continues to show it has ‘significant advantages’ over rivals, analyst says in boosting bullish view - MarketWatch
articles.article_text: Piper Sandler analyst Harsh Kumar is feeling increasingly upbeat about Nvidia Corp.’s stock and positioning after taking a deeper dive into the company’s networking opportunity. Kumar hosted two Nvidia NVDA executives Wednesday for a conversation that ended up being well-timed in light of a report from earlier in the week indicating that the Commerce Department may introduce additional restrictions on the export of artificial-intelligence chips to China. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress shared at the Piper event that she didn’t expect an “immediate material impact” from possible extended bans. Emily Bary is MarketWatch's assistant managing editor, tech. She is based in New York. Copyright © 2026 MarketWatch, Inc. All rights reserved.

articles.title: Nvidia CFO Expects No Significant Impact From Latest US Embargo

articles.article_title: Nvidia CFO Expects No Significant Impact From Latest US Embargo
articles.article_text: Nvidia Corp (NYSE: NVDA ) and several peer chipmakers were trading lower Wednesday amid reports of the U.S. adopting a stricter stance over China's AI ambitions . The U.S. plans to tighten export controls announced in October to restrict sales of some artificial-intelligence chips to China, amid growing concerns about selling the technology to a critical strategic competitor, Bloomberg reports . Nvidia CFO Colette Kress said he is aware of the new restrictions and expects no material change to its earnings from the latest embargo. The move partly aimed at Nvidia's A800 chip, which the chipmaker designed after the earlier controls. China accounts for 20% - 25% of China's data center sales. Any ban on exports to that country would represent a loss of opportunity, she added, Bloomberg notes. Price Action: NVDA shares traded lower by 2.31% at $409.13 on the last check Wednesday. articles.article_text: A whale with a lot of money to spend has taken a noticeably bullish stance on NVIDIA . Looking at options history for NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA ) we detected 48 strange trades. If we consider the specifics of each trade, it is accurate to state that 54% of the investors opened trades with bullish expectations and 45% with bearish. From the overall spotted trades, 12 are puts, for a total amount of $1,027,344 and 36, calls, for a total amount of $1,818,612. Taking into account the Volume and Open Interest on these contracts, it appears that whales have been targeting a price range from $280.0 to $430.0 for NVIDIA over the last 3 months. Looking at the volume and open interest is an insightful way to conduct due diligence on a stock. This data can help you track the liquidity and interest for NVIDIA's options for a given strike price. Below, we can observe the evolution of the volume and open interest of calls and puts, respectively, for all of NVIDIA's whale activity within a strike price range from $280.0 to $430.0 in the last 30 days. With a volume of 2,698,125, the price of NVDA is up 2.0% at $416.38. RSI indicators hint that the underlying stock may be approaching overbought. Next earnings are expected to be released in 54 days. Mizuho downgraded its action to Buy with a price target of $400 Rosenblatt downgraded its action to Buy with a price target of $600 Morgan Stanley has decided to maintain their Overweight rating on NVIDIA, which currently sits at a price target of $500. Daiwa Capital upgraded its action to Outperform with a price target of $475 Options are a riskier asset compared to just trading the stock, but they have higher profit potential. Serious options traders manage this risk by educating themselves daily, scaling in and out of trades, following more than one indicator, and following the markets closely.
